label: the pre-fix send window consumes a reply without raising the pill
test: cd ui && VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2 npx vitest run src/pages/TaskDetailPage.newActivityPin.dom.test.tsx -t "a reply that lands while a follow-up send is pending raises the new-activity pill"

label: the pre-fix send window consumes a reply the pending restore held the pin for
test: cd ui && VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2 npx vitest run src/pages/TaskDetailPage.newActivityPin.dom.test.tsx -t "a reply that lands when a restore still owes the pin raises the pill at the restored place"

label: an owed send pin drags a reader who scrolled away from a pending restore back to the end
test: cd ui && VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2 npx vitest run src/pages/TaskDetailPage.newActivityPin.dom.test.tsx -t "a reader who scrolls away from a pending restore keeps their place when the reply lands"

label: a send no longer owns a pin, so its bubble sent from away never comes into view
test: cd ui && VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2 npx vitest run src/pages/TaskDetailPage.newActivityPin.dom.test.tsx -t "the send's own bubble still pins to the end once"
